preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.
Each string a must have a length between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ANTO' for c in a)
preconditions.description: Each character in string a must be one of 'A', 'N', 'T', or 'O'.

postconditions.description: The output string b must be a permutation of the input string a.
The length of the output string b must be equal to the length of the input string a.

postconditions.expression: any(b != a for b in permutations(a))
postconditions.description: The output string b must be different from the input string a if possible.
